instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Trixie Toucan lives in the rainforest. Her best friend is Emmy Macaw. Emmy lives one layer of the rainforest higher than Trixie.
atoms.sound: ssml: A Feast for Friends <break time='1000ms'/> Trixie Toucan lives in the rainforest. Her best friend is Emmy Macaw. Emmy lives one layer of the rainforest higher than Trixie.

atoms.text: They meet in their favourite tree. The tree is very large with many leaves. They search for food to share together.
atoms.sound: They meet in their favourite tree. The tree is very large with many leaves. They search for food to share together.

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story so far?
b: Trixie and Emmy live far away from each other.

atoms.text:
“I want figs today!” says Trixie excitedly.
“You always want figs,” says Emmy. Emmy didn’t like figs very much. Emmy would rather have nuts.
atoms.sound: <voice voice='f1'>“I want figs today!”</voice> says Trixie excitedly.<voice voice='f2'>you always want figs,</voice> says Emmy. Emmy didn’t like figs very much. Emmy would rather have nuts.

atoms.text: “I have an idea!” exclaims Emmy. “Let’s find food for each other. I will find figs for you. You can find nuts for me. Then we share.”
atoms.sound:
I have an idea! exclaims Emmy.

Let’s find food for each other. I will find figs for you. You can find nuts for me. Then we share.

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story now?
b: Trixie and Emmy have a fight.
++Trixie and Emmy come up with a plan.

atoms.text: Trixie really likes this idea. Trixie flies to the nut tree. She picks up as many nuts as she can fit in her beak. Emmy grabs as many figs as she can with her feet.
atoms.sound: Trixie really likes this idea. Trixie flies to the nut tree. She picks up as many nuts as she can fit in her beak. Emmy grabs as many figs as she can with her feet.

atoms.text:
The two friends meet back in their favourite tree.
Trixie says, “Thank you for my figs, Emmy! You picked really good ones.”
“Mmhmm welcome!” says Emmy with her mouth full. They laugh together.
atoms.sound: The two friends meet back in their favourite tree. Trixie says <voice voice='f1'>Thank you for my figs, Emmy! You picked really good ones!</voice><voice voice='f2'>Mmhmm welcome!</voice> says Emmy with her mouth full. They laugh together.

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story now?
b: ++Trixie and Emmy are kind to each other.
Trixie and Emmy get sad easily.
